summary: ITER-79 three-bug batch tested end-to-end. Verified Bug #2 (email replacement) and Bug #3 (Adviser→Family plan) shipped clean. FOUND & FIXED a NEW REGRESSION in Bug #1: E1's defensive edits to Onboarding.jsx added a `<Loader2 />` spinner at line 271 but forgot to import Loader2 from lucide-react. This caused the SAME 500 ErrorBoundary the ticket was meant to fix — 'ReferenceError: Loader2 is not defined at Onboarding'. Missing-import is in the allowed-fix scope, so I added `Loader2` to the lucide-react import at line 6. After the fix, re-ran the full flow: login as cathy → dashboard renders `profile-completion-banner` for a seeded incomplete participant (with LEGACY STRING classification_level='3') → clicked `profile-completion-cta` → navigated to /onboarding?pid=... → NO ErrorBoundary → StepEssentials rendered with all 8 classification buttons → Class 3 was visually SELECTED (proves parseInt string-legacy fix works) → provider_name pre-filled ('TEST BlueBerry Care') → last_name/dob blank ready to fill → filled fields, clicked Continue, advanced to Step 2 (authorisation) with NO crash. Bug #2 verified via ripgrep (rg-based test with 15 parametrised targets — all files use support@wayly.com.au; Contact.jsx is the only allowed source with hello@wayly.com.au) AND live-UI: the ServerError.jsx page (which we hit organically during the Loader2 crash) rendered 'support@wayly.com.au'. Bug #3 verified via mongo (0 accounts with base_plan='ADVISER' — was 8 pre-migration) AND live Billing tab: 'BASE PLAN / FAMILY / $39.00/mo' shown for Cathy, no ADVISER anywhere. Backend pytest suite: 22 passed / 1 skipped (skip: no requires_completion participant present after post-test seed cleanup).

Consider renaming to `programRefVersion` and dropping the disable comment.

rca of the issue: Bug #1 was a compound regression. E1's defensive Onboarding.jsx edits (parseInt for string classification + `??` for hcp_level=0 + _snapshotVersion in useMemo deps) were correct in isolation but shipped alongside an unrelated addition of a `<Loader2 />` spinner in the loading-existing state — without importing Loader2 from lucide-react. This produced `ReferenceError: Loader2 is not defined` at Onboarding component eval time, which the top-level ErrorBoundary caught and redirected to /500 (ServerError.jsx). Ironically, the /500 page correctly displayed `support@wayly.com.au` (proving Bug #2's replacement worked). Mitigation: (1) added `Loader2` to line 6 import; (2) recommended ESLint no-undef in CI to catch this at PR time; (3) test file added asserts server API contracts + string-legacy shape parsing so future regressions in participant deep-link are caught early.
